title: CatalogMenuPublishedPayload
description: Payload of `catalog.menu.published` version 1: a store's menu was rebuilt into a new published document. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's partner. Readers fetch the document at `GET /v1/storefront/stores/{location_id}/menu?version=<version>`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

version.description: The new version of the published menu, which only rises.

revision.description: The catalogue revision the document was built from.

items.description: How many items the published menu carries.
